== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Probe Telemetry (Japanese)|Probe Telemetry]] from [[Hoth (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://www.psacard.com/psasetregistry/showcase/miscellaneous/1998-decipher-star-wars-ccg-japanese-hoth-robert-john/imagegallery/32924 Robert John's Japanese Hoth PSA showcase], [https://d1htnxwo4o0jhw.cloudfront.net/cert/152940015/I2JvAi0lTEiD6WpHyTguLA.jpg source photograph], PSA certificate 86099790.

Crop rectangle <code>(145, 620, 1290, 2220)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>a97a99347c1e2486327b532622676969c6ad7f3c4318e4627aea98180ae2316a</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1998.
